summary: Completed testing of backup/restore with truncated ZIP handling and loan leaderboard feature. All backend APIs work correctly, frontend UI displays properly, and service worker correctly bypasses admin endpoints.
passed_tests: Backend: Truncated ZIP restore (9 MiB) successfully salvages data with salvaged=true flag
Backend: Truncated JSON in ZIP returns clear error message containing 'terpotong'
Backend: GET /api/admin/backup.zip includes X-Backup-Bytes header matching content length
Backend: Backup ZIP contains loan leaderboard reports (06-Peringkat-Rajin-Meminjam/*.pdf and *.xlsx)
Backend: Backup ZIP contains visit leaderboard reports (05-Peringkat-Rajin-Berkunjung)
Backend: Full ZIP restore works with salvaged=false
Backend: GET /api/admin/backup (JSON) returns valid backup data
Frontend: Data & pemeliharaan section displays with hint mentioning 'peringkat rajin meminjam'
Frontend: Reports page has 'Peringkat rajin meminjam' tab
Frontend: Loan leaderboard displays student rankings correctly
Service Worker: API_BYPASS regex includes /api/admin/ to prevent caching
